name: Centipede

C2.note: MPU; the CAT Box procedure has you remove C2 from the PCB

notes: The drawings carry a full CAT Box signature-analysis procedure. Each device has a setup box on the sheet giving exactly where to clip START, STOP and CLOCK — e.g. for P2: START P2 pin 11, STOP P2 pin 11, CLK N1 pin 6 — and the signatures are printed next to the signal point they belong to.
Preliminary set-up removes power, harness, PCB and the MPU at C2, then jumpers pins 37-39 on the MPU socket and connects the CAT Box flex cable to the test edge connector.
